title: Intelligence Profile
description: A versioned, declarative policy bundle describing one Lighthouse intelligence mission. NOT a plugin: a profile may never declare arbitrary executable modules or shell commands. This document is a human/Gateway-facing contract reference; the authoritative enforcer is modules/profiles.py (dataclass validate()).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Unknown/future versions fail closed.

status.description: Maturity. There is deliberately no 'production' or 'active' status.

compatibility.description: Deployment compatibility. Unknown keys fail closed.

privacy_policy.description: local_only:true marks a private profile; such a profile may not enable public_publishing.

data_root.description: If present, must canonically resolve under the /data boundary.

dead_mans_switch_policy.description: Declarative eligibility only. eligible defaults false; enrollment/activation fields (enrolled, activated, active, enabled, armed, scheduled) may never be truthy.

$comment: Policy blocks may not contain executable-intent keys at any depth: module(s), command, cmd, shell, exec, entrypoint, eval, script, run, callable, import, subprocess. This structural rule is enforced by modules/profiles.py, not expressible cleanly here.
